Sonyachne (former Knyazhe) Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Sonyachne — known successively as Knyazhe, then Radyanske after 1922, and Sonyachne only from 1955 — had an extraordinarily concentrated Jewish population: 1,040 of the town's 1,094 residents, or 95 percent, by 1897, one of the highest such shares recorded anywhere in this collection. Most of the town's Jewish families found work at a collective farm established in 1929. German troops arriving on July 22, 1941, murdered those Jews who had neither fled nor been evacuated in time.
